主要内容: On January 19, 2021, Novavax, Inc. signed an advanced purchase agreement with Canada to supply 52 million doses of NVX-CoV2373, its SARS-CoV-2 vaccine candidate, for use in Canada and Canadian personnel. The agreement allows for up to 24 million additional doses. The company agreed to seek regulatory approval in Canada after first submitting in another priority market, such as the U.S., U.K., or EU. The customer may terminate the agreement if the company fails to submit the application. If approved, the company plans to deliver monthly shipments. Novavax also filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering, contemplating up to $500 million in common stock sales. Previously, it sold 3.6 million shares under a sales agreement, generating $466.8 million in net proceeds, with $27.2 million remaining. The November 2020 sales agreement was terminated by mutual consent. Legal opinions on the shares were also filed as exhibits.
